Force Capital Management Llc bought 5,700 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. Force Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $934.07 billion market cap company. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since May 11, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
